flags.reason: The Card CTA guide (e7ed622) and its evidence were checked on 19 October 2026 on the a116616 build; the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02 has a different CardCTA.tsx (12f3f2b at a116616, 037ab56 at dbe0e02), changed by Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 for Component Bug #345, and the evidence's 28 October note says the guide's copy waits for #345's own publish. Read against the installed source and the guide page rendered on it (31 October, headless Chrome, 1280 and 390 px), these sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Anatomy's Title note “nothing cuts it short”, Sizing's “Height follows the text: nothing cuts the title or body short, so longer copy or a narrower host makes the card taller.”, the Long copy caption “More text, a taller card: nothing cuts it short.” and Content's “the card doesn’t cut either short”: the title clamps to one line and the body to three unless disableTruncation is set (CardCTA.tsx lines 519–527); on the page the Long copy body is cut at three lines and at 260 px the title ends in …. (2) Sizing's “The button grows with its label and never wraps.” and the first Don't caption “The button never wraps, so it runs out of the card.”: the card is overflow hidden (305), the Button stretches to its column (386–399) and its label stays on one line and ends in … inside it (Button.tsx 431–438). (3) Configuration's “AppearanceBrand changes only the rating badge.”: the new cta badge prop gets the card's modes too (52, 528); and the AppearanceBrand Secondary caption “The rating badge turns purple, as Figma draws it.”: the rating badge is AppearanceBrand Secondary unless the card's modes set one (285), so it is purple without it. (4) The second Don't caption “A stranger’s photo appears in its place.”: without avatarSource the sip Avatar is a monogram of the title's initials (568–594; the page shows “SA”). (5) The third Don't caption “Its corners poke out past the card’s rounded corners.”: with MediaBlock Image the right column clips to 12 px corners (286–297, 362–374); and the Do & Don'ts description's “overflows, shows a stranger, or breaks its corners”. (6) Sources: “… while the package’s cta shows an icon and no badge or caption; a picture passed through iconSlot isn’t clipped to the card’s corners.” (badge and caption props, 45–56, 528–531), “the package’s is gold until you pass it.”, “Nothing cuts the title or body short, a long button label runs out of the card, ratingMediaAlign doesn’t move the default badge, and without avatarSource sip shows a stock photo.” (641–647 move the badge) and the 9,999 px measuring copy sentence (gone: the page's scrollWidth equals its width). Still open on dbe0e02 and not in the guide or evidence, so not listed as gaps: every default Button fills its column instead of hugging its label (Component Bug #414, In progress); and from #345's 27 October re-test, a long badge isn't truncated or held to its column, the badge-to-title gap is 6 px where Figma's is 16, and the caption is 12/16 regular where Figma's is 14/16 medium. The guide is updated when Component Bug #345 publishes (the Component Fix flow updates the guide copy a fix changed; the sentences are listed in a note on #345), then a new Agent pack ticket re-extracts. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r26, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #345.

The greeting and balance are the guide’s; onPressButton stands for the screen opening its own setup flow (the card doesn’t do the setup or remove itself).

  <CardCTA
    type="cta"
    title="Set up UPI Number"
    body="Receive money on your mobile number."
    iconName="ic_upi_number"
    buttonLabel="Set up"
    onPressButton={() => {}}
  />
</VStack>

props.name: type
props.description: Visual layout variant. `'cta'` (default) is the horizontal CTA card, `'rating'` is the rating card, and `'sip'` is the avatar-led card with a headline/description/subtitle footer. PascalCase Figma names (`'CTA' | 'Rating' | 'Sip'`) are also accepted. Default "cta", from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text. Default "If you have 1 line", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.default: Then you can have up to 3 lines in the subtext as well. This is for demonstration.
props.description: Body / subtitle text. Default "Then you can have up to 3 lines in the subtext as well. This is for demonstration.", from the component source.

props.name: badge
props.description: Optional chip on the cta layout, including Figma's picture CTA. A string renders a `Badge`. A node replaces it. `false`, `null`, and `''` hide it. Omitted by default.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional caption under the body on the cta layout (Figma's picture CTA). `false`, `null`, and `''` hide it. Omitted by default.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Icon name for the default IconCapsule on the right. Default "ic_upi_number", from the component source.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Left out, the default Button reads “Button”, or “Save” on rating. Declared: Label for the default Button.

props.name: onPressButton
props.description: Callback for the default Button press.

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: Label shown in the rating badge. Default "+28 Rating", from the component source.

props.name: showRatingActions
props.description: Show like/dislike actions in the rating footer. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: showButton
props.description: [rating] Show the primary footer button (default `Save` / `buttonSlot`). When `false`, only rating actions render and they stay start-aligned — no empty button slot and no consumer `buttonSlot={<Fragment />}` hack. Default: `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: ratingMediaAlign
props.description: [rating] Horizontal alignment of the media / badge slot above the title. Charts and dataviz should use `'center'` (default). Use `'start'` for left-aligned badges/labels. Default "center", from the component source.

props.name: onPressLike
props.description: Callback for the default like action.

props.name: onPressDislike
props.description: Callback for the default dislike action.

props.name: headline
props.description: [sip] Headline text shown above the description row. Default "Headline", from the component source.

props.name: description
props.description: [sip] Description text (left of subtitle) Default "Description", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: [sip] Subtitle text (right of description) Default "Subtitle", from the component source.

props.name: avatarSource
props.description: [sip] Image source for the default Avatar.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, title and body wrap freely. When omitted, title clamps to one line and body to three, matching the docs.

props.name: likeAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default Like control. Defaults to `Like`. Default "Like", from the component source.

props.name: dislikeAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default Dislike control. Defaults to `Dislike`. Default "Dislike", from the component source.

props.name: iconAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default IconCapsule. Omit it to hide the icon from the accessibility tree (decorative).

props.name: avatarAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default sip Avatar. Omit it to hide the avatar from the accessibility tree (decorative).

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration for design token resolution.

props.name: iconSlot
props.description: Slot: replaces the default icon area (right side)

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: Slot: replaces the default Button.

props.name: ratingBadgeSlot
props.description: Slot: replaces the default rating badge.

props.name: ratingActionsSlot
props.description: Slot: replaces the default like/dislike action group.

props.name: avatarSlot
props.description: [sip] Slot: replaces the default Avatar.

props.name: style
props.description: Container style overrides.

props.name: ...Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof View>, 'children' | 'style'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: The card sets AppearanceBrand Secondary on its own Button and IconCapsule over its modes, so AppearanceBrand on the card doesn’t change either. Declared: A token collection CardCTA reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
